# Notes

This document DESCRIBES the markers an audit looks for: TODO, FIXME, HACK, XXX, and
NotImplementedException. Naming them in prose must not be reported as unfinished code.

It also names scheduler and routing technologies in prose — Celery, Sidekiq, BullMQ, node-cron,
`@Scheduled`, `IHostedService`, and `app.get(` — none of which this fixture implements.
